sample: Latest relevant commit on each active calendar day, plus the current worktree.

methodology.solidTiles: Foreground cells whose resolved tile registration blocks movement; slopes are included.
methodology.lines: Non-blank first-party C# source lines after comments and literals are removed; generated FMOD bindings and external code are excluded.
methodology.complexity: Aggregate McCabe complexity across C# methods: one per method plus branches, cases, catches, ternaries, and short-circuit operators.
methodology.decisionDensity: Aggregate cyclomatic complexity per 1,000 first-party C# source lines.
methodology.topTenGravity: Percentage of first-party C# source lines contained in the ten largest source files.
methodology.terrainPressure: Movement-blocking foreground cells as a percentage of all room tile-space in the selected world.
methodology.castDiversity: The exponential of Shannon entropy across placed actor types: the equivalent number of equally common types.
methodology.novelCombinations: Previously unseen pairs of gameplay actor types placed in the same room during a historical interval; infrastructure and decorative actors are excluded.
methodology.reuseCombinations: Novel co-locations made entirely from actor types already placed in an earlier interval.
methodology.designDistance: Average nearest-room distance on a 0–100 scale, weighted by gameplay-actor mix, terrain pressure, room area, and aspect ratio.
methodology.interactionTriangles: Rooms containing at least three distinct gameplay actor types after infrastructure and decorative actors are excluded.
